characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Oddish is a grass and poison type Pokémon that buries itself in the ground by day to absorb nutrients and moves about at night to scatter seeds. It fights by discharging toxic spores and powders, or utilizing grass-type vines and energy attacks.

mechanisms: Burying underground during daytime to avoid detection
Paralyzing or putting attackers to sleep with status powders

limitations: Cannot move around freely during daylight hours due to its plant-like nature

sources.supports: Basic attributes, types, and standard movepool including status powders.

feats.claim: Emits toxic or sleep-inducing powders from its leaves to incapacitate foes
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entries

campaignTags.claim: Uses the move Absorb to drain HP from opponents and heal itself

unknowns: Exact potency of its nocturnal movements and seed scattering outside of game mechanics.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Omanyte is an extinct rock and water type Pokémon that has been successfully revived from a Helix Fossil. It protects its soft body inside a heavy spiral shell and swims using ten tentacles.

mechanisms: Retreating entirely inside its hard spiral shell for protection

limitations: Vulnerable on land due to heavy shell and reliance on aquatic movement

sources.supports: Basic stats, types, fossil revival background, and shell defense mechanisms.

feats.claim: Revived from an ancient Helix Fossil discovered in rock layers

campaignTags.claim: Naturally lives in the sea and swims using ten tentacles
Propels itself through water using tentacles

unknowns: Exact population numbers in prehistoric eras.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Omastar is the evolved form of Omanyte, featuring a much larger and heavier spiral shell equipped with spikes. It uses its tentacles to capture prey and can pierce enemies with its sharp shell structure.

mechanisms: Heavy spiked spiral shell that deflects physical impacts

limitations: The heavy shell restricts its movement speed significantly out of water

sources.supports: Evolutionary progression from Omanyte, heavy shell details, and water/rock moves.

feats.claim: Crushes prey with its heavy shell and absorbs fluids using its tentacles

campaignTags.claim: Aquatic creature that swims in ancient seas

unknowns: Reason for its ancient extinction before modern fossil resurrection technology.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Onix is a massive rock and ground type snake-like Pokémon composed of gigantic boulders. It tunnels through the earth at high speeds, crushing obstacles and opponents with immense physical strength.

mechanisms: Rock-hard body skin that resists physical blows

limitations: Extremely poor special defense and vulnerable to water and grass attacks

sources.supports: Gigantic serpentine physique, rock/ground typing, and tunneling capabilities.

feats.claim: Tunnels through the ground at high speeds, shaking the earth

campaignTags.claim: Exceeds 28 feet in length as a gigantic serpentine rock creature
Massive scale and towering stature compared to standard human-scaled opponents

unknowns: Exact internal mechanism that allows magnetic navigation while tunneling.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Paras is a bug and grass type Pokémon that carries two large mushroom parasites called tochukaso on its back. It relies on these fungi to sap nutrients and utilizes powder attacks in combat.

mechanisms: Releasing status-altering spores to stop attackers before close engagement

limitations: The mushrooms on its back dictate its overall health and direct its movements

sources.supports: Bug/Grass typing, mushroom back parasites, and status powder movepool.

feats.claim: Burrows under tree roots to absorb nutrients alongside its back mushrooms

campaignTags.claim: Absorbs life force to recover energy using Absorb

unknowns: The exact sentient control level exerted by the tochukaso mushroom over the host insect.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Parasect is the evolved form of Paras, where the mushroom parasite on its back has completely overtaken the host insect's central nervous system. It scatters toxic spores and overwhelms opponents in damp forest environments.

mechanisms: Spreading total-infliction spores like Spore to instantly neutralize foes

limitations: Extremely vulnerable to fire and aerial assaults due to fungal composition

sources.supports: Evolutionary details, mushroom control over host, and Spore technique.

feats.claim: Scatters toxic spores from the massive mushroom cap to drain tree nutrients and weaken foes

campaignTags.claim: Drains target energy via Giga Drain

unknowns: Whether any original consciousness of the host Paras remains beneath the giant mushroom.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Persian is a sleek, feline normal-type Pokémon known for its extreme agility, sharp claws, and calculating predatory demeanor. It stalks targets silently before striking with lightning-fast physical combos.

mechanisms: High evasiveness and flexible feline agility to dodge incoming strikes

limitations: Lacks ranged energy projection options without technical machine support

sources.supports: Feline traits, normal typing, agility, and claw techniques.

feats.claim: Sneaks up on opponents without making a single sound before slashing with sharp claws

campaignTags.claim: Stalks prey with noiseless footsteps and calculated stealth

unknowns: The exact temperament variability between wild Persian and domesticated companions.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Pidgeot is a large normal and flying type bird Pokémon capable of soaring at Mach 2 speeds. It generates powerful gusts with its massive wings and strikes enemies from high-altitude dives.

mechanisms: High-speed aerial maneuvering to evade ground-based attacks

limitations: Requires open airspace to maximize its dive speed and wing-based wind pressure

sources.supports: Normal/Flying typing, wing power, and Mach 2 flight speed.

feats.claim: Flies at Mach 2 speed to search for prey from high altitudes

campaignTags.claim: Possesses large wings capable of sustained high-speed flight

unknowns: Maximum sustained duration of Mach 2 flight without resting.

mechanisms: Superior aerial agility and reinforced muscle mass during Mega Evolution

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Pokémon anime
characters.summary: Pidgeotto is the intermediate normal and flying type bird Pokémon that patrols a large territorial area with sharp claws and strong wingbeats. It fights by swooping down and gripping targets.

mechanisms: Kicking up dust screens with Sand-Attack to lower enemy accuracy

limitations: Lacks the extreme Mach 2 speed of its final evolved form Pidgeot

sources.supports: Normal/Flying typing, territorial nature, and Sand-Attack move.

feats.claim: Defends its wide territorial area vigorously by swooping down on intruders

campaignTags.claim: Flies continuously using its developed wings

unknowns: Territory boundary sizes across different woodland biomes.
